theater: 藏南零嘎河谷與瓦弄一線

battle.name: 中印邊境戰爭
battle.theater: 藏南零嘎河谷與瓦弄一線
battle.brief: 一九六二年十月二十日，解放軍在藏南與阿克賽欽兩翼同時進攻，四日內連下零嘎、塔旺與瓦弄一線，十一月十九日宣布停火。卡面這支五六式突擊步槍是入藏與新疆方向步兵排班的制式槍械，在夜渡零嘎、突襲瓦弄與強攻熱藏拉的高原近戰裡，握在射手手上逐壕逐點爭奪陣地。

kit.name: 56式突擊步槍
kit.history: 1956年列裝的中國制式突擊步槍，1962年中印邊境戰爭期間配屬入藏與新疆方向的步兵部隊，用於山地近戰。

countries: 這場戰爭是中華人民共和國與印度共和國之間沿實際控制線爆發的邊境戰事，交戰主力是中國人民解放軍與印度陸軍。中方由中央軍委與總參謀部統籌，攻勢分作東西兩路：東路藏南方向由西藏軍區司令員張國華指揮，投入第四軍、第五軍所屬部隊與後續開進的兵團；西路阿克賽欽方向由新疆軍區司令員王震指揮，投入新疆方向的集群部隊。兩路相距約一千公里，卻在同一天發動攻勢，逐級沿山梁、隘口分割印軍。印軍由陸軍總部統一調度，東段由第四軍團負責，主要作戰單位是第四步兵師、第六十二旅所屬各營與第十山地師；西段阿克賽欽方向兵力極少，多為巡邏分遣隊與前哨哨位。雙方均未正式宣戰，戰事全程在地面進行，解放軍飛機全程未參戰，印度空軍亦未投入攻勢，只負責空投補給。工程兵、通信兵、炮兵與後勤分隊按營、連編制跟進作戰。
countriesEn: This war was a border conflict fought between the People's Republic of China and the Republic of India along the line of actual control, with the Chinese People's Liberation Army and the Indian Army as the opposing forces. On the Chinese side the campaign was directed by the Central Military Commission and the General Staff, and the offensive was split into two prongs. The eastern prong, the southern sector, was under the commander of the Tibet Military Region, Zhang Guohua, and drew on the units of the Fourth and Fifth Armies together with the army groups that moved up afterwards; the western prong, the Aksai Chin, was under the commander of the Xinjiang Military Region, Wang Zhen, and drew on the formations coming out of Xinjiang. The two prongs lay about a thousand kilometres apart, yet they attacked on the same day, cutting the Indian forces apart step by step along the ridges and the passes. The Indian Army was directed by Army Headquarters, with the Fourth Corps responsible for the eastern sector; its main fighting units were the 4th Infantry Division, the battalions of the 62nd Brigade and the 10th Mountain Division. In the far western Aksai Chin sector the Indian presence was a few patrol detachments and forward posts. Neither side formally declared war. The whole campaign was fought on the ground: PLA aircraft took no part at all, and the Indian Air Force was never committed to the offensive, being used only for dropping supplies. Engineer, signal, artillery and service units followed the fighting in battalion and company echelons.
people: 決定開戰的是毛澤東，主持外交收尾的是周恩來。開戰前的判斷，核心是毛澤東把印軍不斷向前推進比作象棋中的渡河，認為對方既然已經越線，就必須一次吃掉，否則邊境永無寧日。國防部長林彪在一九六二年十月六日的高層會議上報告，解放軍情報判定印軍將於十月十日對塔格拉山脊發動代號「雷格霍恩」的攻勢，中樞隨即決定大規模反擊。解放軍總參謀長黃永勝主持前線部署，張國華負責東線，王震負責西線。印方關鍵人物是總理尼赫魯與國防部長克里希那·梅塔，陸軍參謀總長 V. K. Mehra 主張佔領整條麥克馬洪線，第四軍團指揮官 B. M. Kaul 少將在塔格拉方向調兵時仍以為對方只是虛張聲勢。熱藏拉一役，印軍營長 K. K. Lal 指揮的一支百餘人分隊憑藉交叉火力與地形，抵住解放軍整排攻勢。駐美大使加爾布賴思與印度情報機構負責人穆利克都反對出動空軍，理由是中方可能報復。
peopleEn: Mao Zedong decided that there would be a war, and Zhou Enlai handled the diplomatic endgame. The judgement before the fighting began rested on Mao's reading of the Indian forward policy: he compared the Indians' constant pushing forward to crossing a river in Chinese chess, and held that since the other side had already crossed, it had to be eaten up in one stroke, otherwise the frontier would never be quiet. Defence Minister Lin Biao reported at a high level meeting on 6 October 1962 that PLA intelligence had determined the Indians would attack the Thagla Ridge on 10 October in an operation code-named 'Leghorn', and the centre thereupon resolved on a large-scale counterattack. PLA Chief of the General Staff Huang Yongsheng ran the deployment, with Zhang Guohua responsible for the eastern prong and Wang Zhen for the western one. On the Indian side the key figures were Prime Minister Nehru and Defence Minister Krishna Menons; the Chief of the Army Staff, V. K. Mehra, pressed for the occupation of the whole McMahon Line, while the corps commander B. M. Kaul, commanding IV Corps, still believed the Chinese were only bluffing when he shifted troops in the Thagla direction. At Rezang La, a detachment of a little over a hundred men commanded by the battalion commander K. K. Lal held off a Chinese platoon with crossfire and the ground. John Kenneth Galbraith, the American ambassador, and B. N. Mullick, the head of Indian intelligence, both advised against using the air force, on the ground that China might retaliate.
kits: 卡面這支五六式突擊步槍是解放軍步兵的制式槍械，一九五六年起由瀋陽與哈爾濱兩家軍工廠仿製蘇聯 AK-47 成批生產。槍身以沖壓機匣配固定木槍托，槍管長約四百一十五毫米，全槍長約一千零二十五毫米，空槍重約三點八五公斤；槍機採導氣式，導氣活塞直接帶動槍機往復，連發時靠固定式十發彈匣供彈，另有供騎兵與空降兵使用的六發彈匣版本。瞄具為葉式表尺，刻度自一百米至八百米，準星帶防護罩。口徑七點六二乘三十九毫米，槍口初速約每秒七百一十五米，有效射程約二百米，二百米內單發精度足以命中人體目標，後坐行程長，連發時節奏平穩，在狹窄山脊上架住槍身射擊不易散架；多數部隊沒有配發照明瞄具，夜戰靠月光與星光瞄準。戰役中它配屬藏南與新疆方向的步兵排、連，連同五三式重機槍、五六式輕機槍與五三式一二〇毫米迫擊砲、五四式一二二毫米榴彈砲、七五毫米無後坐力砲一同投入；工兵在前面以爆破器材炸開石壘與障礙，步兵再以五六式突擊步槍清壕、封洞、逐點攻擊。印軍方面，輕武器以李-恩菲爾德七點六二毫米步槍為主，配斯特林衝鋒槍與布侖輕機槍，火砲有二十五磅砲、一〇五毫米野砲與三點七吋山砲，迫擊砲有八十一與一二〇毫米兩種。運輸靠解放牌汽車、騾馬與犛牛背運，印軍用吉普、貨車及大量騾馬，並大量使用空投作為高原上的主要補給手段。
kitsEn: The Type 56 assault rifle on the card was the standard weapon of PLA infantry. Beginning in 1956 it went into serial production at the arsenals in Shenyang and Harbin as a copy of the Soviet AK-47. It has a stamped receiver and a fixed wooden stock; the barrel is about four hundred and fifteen millimetres long, the rifle is about one thousand and twenty-five millimetres overall and weighs about three point eight five kilograms empty. The bolt is gas-operated, the gas piston driving the bolt directly back and forth, and automatic fire is fed from a fixed ten-round magazine, with a six-round magazine version issued to cavalry and airborne troops. The sights are a leaf type graduated from one hundred to eight hundred metres, the front sight fitted with a hood. It fires the 7.62x39mm cartridge, with a muzzle velocity of about seven hundred and fifteen metres per second and an effective range of about two hundred metres; single shots inside two hundred metres are accurate enough to hit a man, the bolt travel is long so that automatic fire is steady, and on a narrow ridge the rifle can be braced and fired without breaking up the shot. Most units had no illuminated sights fitted, and night fighting was done by moonlight and starlight. In the campaign the rifle was issued to the platoons and companies in the southern sector and in the Xinjiang direction, going into the line alongside the 53-type heavy machine gun, the 56-type light machine gun, the 53-type 120mm mortar, the 54-type 122mm howitzer and the 75mm recoilless rifle. Sappers went ahead with blasting charges to blow open stone barricades and wire, and the infantry then cleared trenches, sealed caves and attacked point by point with the Type 56. On the Indian side the light weapons were centred on the 7.62mm Lee-Enfield rifle, with Sterling submachine guns and Bren light machine guns; the artillery included the 25-pounder, the 105mm field gun and the 3.7-inch mountain gun, with 81mm and 120mm mortars. Transport was by Jiefang truck, by mule and by yak carrying loads on their backs; the Indians used jeeps, lorries and a great many mules, and relied heavily on air dropping as their principal means of resupply in the highlands.
tactics: 解放軍的戰術重點是夜戰行軍、多路穿插、各個殲滅，靠迫擊砲與山砲的火力密度決定山口的歸屬；突擊步槍在這種打法中既是近戰武器，也是陣地上的制壓武器。零嘎河谷最具代表性：印軍把兵力集中在五座橋的渡口，解放軍於枯水期涉水渡河，在夜色中於南岸編成營，凌晨五時十四分以迫擊砲火開始壓制，同時剪斷印軍電話線，六時三十分步兵自背後發動襲擊，隨後以連續迂迴把印軍逼離陣地。瓦弄一線，二十二日零時十五分解放軍迫擊砲開火，約四百人攻擊印軍陣地，第一波被印軍準確的迫擊砲火擋住，補充兵力後再攻，終以人數優勢突破；塔旺一線則在沒有遇到抵抗的情況下被放棄。工兵部隊在前面以爆破器材炸開石壘，步兵隨即以五六式突擊步槍逐壕搜索、封鎖洞口。十一月戰事重啟：十七日不走公路，改走山徑攻擊塞拉與邦迪拉，切斷公路並割裂約一萬名印軍；十八日凌晨四時三十五分在楚舒爾方向發動密集步兵攻擊，五時四十五分打到古隆山，印軍砲兵未能頂住優勢兵力，九時前守軍退出古隆山與斯潘古山口。同一時間解放軍在熱藏拉攻擊守軍一百二十三人的印軍陣地，遭到交叉火力阻擊而未能得手。解放軍飛機全程未參戰；印軍雖曾要求出動空軍，最終沒有把空軍投入攻勢作戰。
tacticsEn: The Chinese tactics rested on night movement, attack by several routes and destruction in separated groups, with the density of mortar and mountain gun fire deciding which pass would be held; in this manner of fighting the assault rifle was both a close combat weapon and the means of suppressing the enemy's positions. The action in the Namka Chu valley is the clearest case. The Indians had concentrated on the crossings of five bridges, but the Chinese forded the river in the shallows of the dry season, formed up into battalions on the southern bank under cover of darkness, opened with mortar fire at 5.14 in the morning, cut the Indian telephone lines at the same moment, and sent the infantry in from the rear at about 6.30, then rolled the defenders off their positions with a series of flanking moves. At Walong the Chinese mortars opened fire at 12.15 a.m. on 22 October and some four hundred men attacked the Indian positions; the first assault was checked by accurate Indian mortar fire, and only after reinforcement did a second assault break through, weight of numbers deciding the day. Tawang was abandoned without resistance. Sappers went ahead with blasting charges to open the stone barricades, and the infantry then searched the trenches trench by trench and sealed the cave positions with the Type 56. When the war resumed in mid November the Chinese changed their method on 17 November, approaching Se La and Bomdi La along a mountain trail rather than the road, cutting the road and isolating some ten thousand Indian troops. Early on 18 November, at 4.35 in the morning, they launched a dense infantry attack in the Chushul sector and struck Gurung Hill at 5.45; Indian artillery could not hold off the superior numbers, and the defenders withdrew from Gurung Hill and from Spangur Gap before nine o'clock. At the same time the Chinese attacked the position at Rezang La held by 123 Indian troops and were repulsed there by crossfire. The PLA committed no aircraft at all. The Indians did press for the air force to be used, but in the end did not commit it to the offensive.
data: 可以引用的數字大致如下。印度主張的邊界全長三千四百八十八公里，阿克賽欽爭議區約三萬八千平方公里，藏南的東北邊疆署轄區約九萬平方公里，東、西兩個戰區相距約一千公里。兵力方面，解放軍投入約八萬人，印方投入約二萬二千人；開戰時印軍在戰區內只有兩個師，準備嚴重不足。卡面這支五六式突擊步槍的諸元是：口徑七點六二乘三十九毫米，空槍重約三點八五公斤，全長約一千零二十五毫米，槍管長約四百一十五毫米，固定式十發彈匣，有效射程約二百米，槍口初速約每秒七百一十五米，表尺範圍一百至八百米；自一九五六年成批生產至六十年代中期，兩家軍工廠的累計產量以百萬枝計（各家統計略有出入）。時間軸上，一九六二年六月印軍在塔格拉山脊下的多拉哨所建立，八月中方佔領山脊頂部，九月二十日零嘎爆發交火，十月十日印軍一支五十人的拉其普特巡邏隊在玉姆措拉撞上約一千人的解放軍工事陣地，十月二十日東西兩路同時進攻，十月二十二日至二十四日連下零嘎、塔旺、瓦弄與楚舒爾北面哨所，十月二十六日周恩來致信尼赫魯提出雙方各退二十公里的方案，十月二十七日尼赫魯回信，十一月十四日印軍在瓦弄反攻，十一月十七日塞拉與邦迪拉失守，十一月十八日楚舒爾與熱藏拉打成僵持，十一月十九日周恩來宣布十一月二十一日午夜起停火，十二月一日起解放軍開始後撤，十二月下旬完成。傷亡方面，中方公布陣亡七百二十二人、受傷一千六百九十七人，印方則宣稱在熱藏拉擊斃解放軍一千三百餘人；印方自己的統計為陣亡一千三百八十三人、失蹤一千六百九十六人、受傷五百四十八至一千零四十七人、被俘三千九百六十八人，中方來源亦記印軍被俘三千九百六十八人。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. The border claimed by India runs for three thousand four hundred and eighty-eight kilometres; the disputed area of Aksai Chin covers about thirty-eight thousand square kilometres, the North-East Frontier Agency administered by India about ninety thousand, and the two theatres, east and west, lay roughly a thousand kilometres apart. On strength, the PLA committed about eighty thousand men and India about twenty-two thousand, while only two Indian divisions were present in the theatre at the outbreak and the preparations were badly inadequate. The figures of the Type 56 assault rifle on the card are these: calibre 7.62x39mm, weight about three point eight five kilograms empty, length overall about one thousand and twenty-five millimetres, barrel about four hundred and fifteen millimetres, fixed ten-round magazine, effective range about two hundred metres, muzzle velocity about seven hundred and fifteen metres per second, and a sight graduated from one hundred to eight hundred metres; from the start of serial production in 1956 to the middle of the 1960s the two arsenals turned out a total measured in millions of rifles, the various published totals differing slightly. On the timeline: in June 1962 the Indians established Dhola Post below the Thagla Ridge; in August Chinese troops occupied the top of the ridge; on 20 September fighting broke out at Namka Chu; on 10 October an Indian Rajput patrol of fifty men at Yumtso La ran into an emplaced Chinese position of about a thousand men; on 20 October the two prongs attacked simultaneously; between 22 and 24 October Namka Chu, Tawang, Walong and the outposts north of Chushul fell; on 26 October Zhou Enlai wrote to Nehru proposing a mutual withdrawal of twenty kilometres, and Nehru replied on the 27th; on 14 November the Indians counterattacked at Walong; on 17 November Se La and Bomdi La were lost; on 18 November Chushul and Rezang La deadlocked; on 19 November Zhou declared a ceasefire from midnight on 21 November; the Chinese began withdrawing from 1 December and finished later that month. On casualties, China published 722 dead and 1,697 wounded, while India claimed to have killed more than 1,300 Chinese at Rezang La; the Indian figures are 1,383 dead, 1,696 missing, 548 to 1,047 wounded and 3,968 captured, and Chinese sources record the same 3,968 Indian prisoners.
cause: 直接起因是實際控制線一線長期存在的進退之爭。一九五四年中印協定以和平共處五項原則為框架，約定以現有實際控制線為基礎談判解決邊界問題；一九五六年中國政府明確提出阿克賽欽在中國境內，印方不接受。一九五九年十一月七日周恩來在德里與尼赫魯會談，雙方同意以實際控制線作為邊界線，此後數年談判反而停滯。一九六〇年雙方再就邊界方案交換意見而無結果；同年印方成立邊界委員會，任命蔣彥棠為首席代表，提出的方案實質要求中國交出藏南大片地區，中方駁回。印軍在此期間不斷以巡邏與前哨哨位向南推進，越出實際控制線，中方視之為逐步兼併。印軍越界有實際事例：十月二十日前的塔格拉山脊爭奪中，一支五十人的印度巡邏隊在玉姆措拉撞上約一千人的解放軍工事陣地，毫無接觸準備即被包圍。印度國內的判斷則輕敵，軍方在戰前普遍認為不會開戰，九月的估計甚至認為幾發炮彈就能把中國人趕走。十月六日解放軍高層會議判定印軍將於十月十日攻擊塔格拉山脊，中樞隨即決定以大規模反擊予以懲戒，十四日人民日報發出最後警告，十月二十日東西兩路同時開火。
causeEn: The immediate cause was the long running argument over who would give way along the line of actual control. The 1954 Sino-Indian agreement was framed by the five principles of peaceful coexistence and provided that the boundary would be settled by negotiation on the basis of the existing line of actual control. In 1956 the Chinese government stated explicitly that Aksai Chin lay within Chinese territory, and India would not accept this. On 7 November 1959 Zhou Enlai met Nehru in Delhi and the two agreed to take the line of actual control as the boundary line; the talks then made no further progress for several years. In 1960 the two sides exchanged proposals on the boundary without result; that year India set up a boundary commission headed by Chiang Yen-t'ang, whose draft in substance demanded the return of large parts of the southern sector to India, and this was rejected by the Chinese side. In the meantime Indian patrols and posts kept pushing south across the line of actual control, which Beijing read as incremental annexation. There were concrete cases of Indian encroachment: in the fighting for the Thagla Ridge before 20 October, a fifty-strong Indian patrol met an emplaced Chinese position of about a thousand men at Yumtso La and was surrounded with no chance to make contact. Indian judgement at home was complacent; the army generally assumed that no war would come, and a September estimate held that a few rounds would send the Chinese running. At the high level meeting of 6 October the Chinese leadership concluded that the Indians would attack the Thagla Ridge on 10 October and resolved on a large-scale counterattack as punishment. The People's Daily issued a final warning on the 14th, and the two prongs struck on 20 October.
impact: 戰後的邊界局勢與雙方軍隊都改了樣子。藏南河谷與阿克賽欽西段留在中國控制之下，實際控制線整體西移；印方在此後二十多年把主要邊疆精力放在西線對付巴基斯坦。印度國內震動更大：國防部長克里希那·梅塔辭職，陸軍指揮層被大改組，政府委託的調查寫成亨德森-布魯克斯-巴加特報告，檢討敗因；軍隊在兩年內把兵力擴充到一倍以上，並全面重做高海拔作戰的訓練、後勤與裝備，一九六五年另成立邊境保安部隊專責邊防。國際上，埃及、緬甸、柬埔寨、斯里蘭卡、加納與印尼六國於一九六二年十二月十日在科倫坡會商，只要求中國單方面後撤二十公里，未能指責中國，令印度失望；美國在一九六三年五月的國安會議上討論了中國再度攻擊印度時的應變方案；蘇聯因古巴導彈危機無暇他顧，但中印交惡後加快向印度供應武器。巴基斯坦在一九六二年十月與中國開始邊界談判，一九六三年簽訂中巴邊界條約，放棄了克什米爾北線的主張。此後局勢一路演變，一九六七年那木拉與巧拉再起衝突，一九八七年雙方克制未開火，一九九三與一九九六年先後簽訂雙邊和平與相互信任條約，二〇〇六年七月乃堆拉口岸重新開放，二〇一一年底雙方同意自二〇一二年恢復年度防務對話。
impactEn: After the war the border situation and the armed forces of both sides had changed. The southern valleys of the eastern sector and western Aksai Chin remained under Chinese control and the line of actual control shifted west as a whole; for the next two decades India concentrated its main frontier effort on the western sector against Pakistan. The shock inside India was greater. Defence Minister Krishna Menon resigned, the command structure of the army was reshuffled, and the government commissioned an inquiry that produced the Henderson Brooks-Bhagat report on the causes of the defeat; the army more than doubled its manpower within two years and overhauled its training, logistics and equipment for warfare at high altitude, and in 1965 a separate Border Security Force was raised to take over frontier duty. Internationally, six non-aligned states, Egypt, Burma, Cambodia, Sri Lanka, Ghana and Indonesia, met at Colombo on 10 December 1962, asked only that China withdraw twenty kilometres unilaterally and declined to condemn China, which disappointed India. In May 1963 the United States National Security Council discussed contingency planning for a further Chinese attack, while the Soviet Union, absorbed by the Cuban Missile Crisis, had no time to spare but soon increased its arms supply to India once Sino-Indian relations soured. Pakistan opened border negotiations with China in October 1962 and in 1963 signed the China-Pakistan border treaty, dropping its claim to the northern line in Kashmir. From there the situation ran on: clashes at Nathu La and Cho La in 1967, a bloodless mutual standoff in 1987, the bilateral peace and tranquility accords of 1993 and 1996, the reopening of the Nathu La crossing in July 2006, and the agreement of late 2011 to resume the annual defence dialogue from 2012.
result: 就一九六二年這一役的直接結果而言：解放軍在戰術上取得全面勝利，零嘎河谷、塔旺、瓦弄與楚舒爾北面的哨所逐一易手，印軍第四師退守塞拉與邦迪拉仍被割裂，約一萬人被切斷在公路一線，解放軍前鋒一度推進到距阿薩姆邦邊境約五十公里的德茲普爾方向，印軍在塔旺方向未作抵抗即撤出。只有熱藏拉一役解放軍攻不下守軍一百二十三人的陣地，是全役少數中國軍吃虧的戰鬥。停火由周恩來於十一月十九日宣布，十一月二十一日午夜生效，條款寫明：自十二月一日起解放軍邊防部隊退到一九五九年十一月七日實際控制線後方二十公里，東線退到麥克馬洪線以北並再後撤二十公里，中線與西線退到實際控制線後方二十公里；十二月一日起部隊開始離開印方管轄區，十二月下旬完成撤退。實際控制線往西移了數十公里，藏南河谷與阿克賽欽西段並未交還，印方始終不承認實際控制線即兩國邊界。長期結果是一條沒有斷線的僵持：一九六七年那木拉與巧拉的衝突中解放軍被迫退出錫金，一九八七年雙方克制，二〇二〇年中印士兵在加勒萬河谷再度交火並出現傷亡，二〇二二年又有揚茨事端。半個多世紀裡，兩國在實際控制線上再沒有爆發大規模地面戰。
resultEn: As to the immediate outcome of the 1962 campaign: China won a complete tactical victory. The Namka Chu valley, Tawang, Walong and the outposts north of Chushul changed hands one after another. The Indian 4th Division fell back on Se La and Bomdi La and was cut off, some ten thousand men isolated along the road, and the Chinese spearhead advanced to within about fifty kilometres of the Assam frontier in the direction of Tezpur, while the Indians abandoned Tawang without resistance. Only at Rezang La did the Chinese fail to take a position held by 123 Indian troops, one of the few Chinese reverse of the whole campaign. The ceasefire was announced by Zhou Enlai on 19 November and took effect at midnight on 21 November, its terms stating that from 1 December the Chinese frontier guards would withdraw to positions twenty kilometres behind the line of actual control that had existed on 7 November 1959, that in the eastern sector they would withdraw to the north of the McMahon Line and twenty kilometres back from it, and that in the middle and western sectors they would withdraw twenty kilometres from the line of actual control. From 1 December the troops began leaving Indian administered territory and the withdrawal was completed later in December. The line of actual control had moved west by tens of kilometres; the southern valleys and western Aksai Chin were not given back, and India has never accepted the line of actual control as the frontier between the two countries. The long term result was a standoff that never broke: Chinese forces were forced out of Sikkim in the clashes at Nathu La and Cho La in 1967, both sides showed restraint in 1987, soldiers of both sides were killed in the Galwan Valley fighting of 2020, and there was a further clash at Yangtse in 2022. For more than half a century the two countries did not fight another large-scale ground war on the line of actual control.
